name: VideoGen
description: VideoGen lets agents create videos, images, voiceovers, and music from a script or prompt in the signed-in VideoGen account. Each user signs in to their own VideoGen account through the browser.

prompts.text: Make a 60-second explainer video from this product description.
Create a voiceover for this script in a calm, clear voice.
Turn this blog post into a short vertical video for social media.

apps.name: VideoGen
apps.description: Video, image, and voiceover generation, over VideoGen's MCP server with browser sign-in.
